headline: Contested Fronts Stir Amid Heavy Fighting
war_summary: The latest returns show several contested sectors still commanding the map, though the immediate tempo is uneven. LinnMercy remains a principal danger line, with 26 strategic-base events in 24 hours and nine Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral holding; its casualty surge has cooled in the latest window. PalantineBerm records 30 daily events across a four-three split with both sides accelerating losses, while Godcrofts’ 46-event day has gone quiet for two hours despite nine Colonial-held bases and no Warden foothold. StlicanShelf has the freshest notable movement, with 17 events in the day and one event inside two hours, amid eight Colonial and one Warden positions. NevishLine, holding seven Warden and one Colonial base, posted 14 daily events and one recent exchange, with enlistments rising on the hour. WeatheredExpanse remains heavily contested in effect, showing 24 daily events and seven Warden bases against two neutral positions, but no movement in the latest six hours. MarbanHollow also retains a four-three split and 23 daily events, although its newest activity is older. Most other regions report no strategic-base events.
